description: Source of truth for every tool the harness knows about: enabled, gated, pending approval, human-only or rejected. Checked by harness/scripts/validate-tools.mjs. Agent grants come from harness/policy/agent-policy.json; each entry's 'grant' says how to find them. docs/harness/TOOL-REGISTRY.md embeds a generated table from this file.

notes: Source is in this repository and reviewed with it.
No dependencies; the MCP protocol subset is implemented directly, so there is no SDK to pin.

microsoft-learn.egress: search text and URLs go to learn.microsoft.com

notes: A remote service cannot be version-pinned; the publisher can change it. Mitigations: explicit tool allow-filter, output treated as untrusted, read-only annotations re-checked at discovery.
Discovery on 2026-10-28 listed exactly three tools, each annotated readOnlyHint true and destructiveHint false.

azure-mcp.egress: Azure Resource Manager and Azure Monitor APIs for the signed-in account; optional Microsoft telemetry unless disabled
azure-mcp.auth: az login (explicit human approval required; not performed)

notes: Tarball downloaded with npm pack --ignore-scripts and read; nothing was installed or run.

package.json has a postinstall script; it only checks that a platform package resolved. index.js can run an install command at runtime if the platform package is missing, so install it once, by a human, with scripts disabled, instead of letting npx fetch it.
npm latest dist-tag on the review date was 4.0.0-beta.3 (a beta). 3.0.0 is the latest stable release and is the version pinned here. Re-review before moving.
Documented flag --read-only was confirmed in upstream test sources, not by running the binary. Namespace flags are unverified until the binary can be run after approval.
Its own documentation lists mutating example prompts; read-only mode and an allow-filter are therefore both required.

github-mcp-server.egress: GitHub API for the signed-in account
github-mcp-server.auth: OAuth or a read-only token supplied by the host; never stored in a repository file

notes: Latest release on the review date was v2.0.3.
Copilot CLI already ships a built-in github-mcp-server, enabled by default in that product. Specialist agents cannot use it: their tool lists omit it and the agent guard denies it.
Not configured here because issues, pull request text and file contents from GitHub are untrusted input and need explicit approval.

tools.name: git status|diff|log|show
tools.purpose: Inspect local repository state and history
tools.inputs: a single git subcommand with simple arguments
tools.notes: Anchored allow-list; no --output option; no chaining.

tools.name: git add|commit|branch|push
tools.purpose: Change local or remote repository state
tools.notes: No agent may run these. Pushes need explicit owner approval; the repository-wide policy hook asks on push.

tools.name: gh pr|run list|view|checks
tools.purpose: Read pull request and workflow run status
tools.inputs: gh subcommand with simple arguments; --web and --watch are refused
tools.egress: GitHub API using the developer's existing gh sign-in
tools.notes: Pull request and log text is untrusted. Results are observations; record evidence through the recorder.

tools.name: gh pr create|merge, gh api with write methods, gh workflow run
tools.purpose: Create or change remote GitHub state
tools.notes: Pull request creation and merge are human actions.

tools.name: search (grep, glob)
tools.purpose: Search repository contents and file names
tools.notes: Native; preferred over any custom search.

tools.name: github-mcp-server (read-only endpoint)
tools.purpose: Search code, issues and pull requests on GitHub
tools.notes: Candidate in harness/tools/mcp-candidates.json; not configured.

tools.name: az (list|show|get|query verbs)
tools.purpose: Read existing Azure resource state
tools.notes: Needs az login, which has not been approved or done. No Azure resource exists to read.

tools.name: az graph query
tools.purpose: Query resource inventory across subscriptions
tools.notes: Needs sign-in and a subscription decision (D-037). Query text is not allow-listed yet.

tools.name: az bicep build|lint
tools.purpose: Compile and lint Bicep offline
tools.egress: none after the Bicep CLI is installed
tools.notes: Phase 0 forbids Bicep. Becomes usable only after a human raises the phase and a policy change adds a pattern for it.

tools.name: azure-mcp (read-only mode)
tools.purpose: Read Azure and Bicep schema information through MCP
tools.notes: Candidate with pinned version in harness/tools/mcp-candidates.json; not configured; no authentication performed.

tools.name: az create|delete|update, azd up|deploy|provision, terraform apply
tools.purpose: Create, change or deploy Azure resources
tools.notes: HC-11: no autonomous deployment. The repository-wide policy hook denies these.

tools.name: microsoft_docs_search
tools.purpose: Search official Microsoft documentation
tools.notes: Queries must never contain project secrets or customer data.

tools.name: microsoft_docs_fetch
tools.purpose: Fetch a Microsoft Learn page as markdown
tools.notes: Record the URL and access date next to every fact used.

tools.name: microsoft_code_sample_search
tools.purpose: Search official Microsoft code samples
tools.notes: Samples are untrusted code; reviewed like any code before use.

tools.name: web_fetch (host allow-list)
tools.purpose: Read a page on an approved documentation host
tools.inputs: https URL on an allowed host
tools.notes: The agent guard allows only the exact hosts in webHosts, over https, and refuses search. Only the initial URL is checked; a redirect to another host is not seen.

tools.name: web_fetch on standards-body sites
tools.purpose: Read public pages of standards and certification bodies
tools.notes: Candidate hosts, unverified. The owner decides which standards are in scope (TODO T4); only then are hosts added to webHosts. Standards are candidates, not confirmed applicable.

tools.name: web_search
tools.purpose: Open-ended web search
tools.egress: query text to a search service
tools.notes: Unbounded sources and synthesised answers cannot be tied to a primary source; the guard denies it.

tools.name: read (view)
tools.purpose: Read files and folders
tools.notes: Secret-shaped strings are redacted from results by the output hook.

tools.name: edit (create, edit)
tools.purpose: Create and change files inside the agent's own scope
tools.notes: Scope comes from agent-policy.json writes; the agent guard enforces it. Control-plane paths ask a human.

tools.name: execute (shell)
tools.purpose: Run an allow-listed single command
tools.notes: Only executors have it, with anchored command patterns. Not a sandbox: a permitted test runner executes whatever the tests contain.

tools.name: npm|pip|dotnet install, winget, choco
tools.purpose: Add or update dependencies
tools.notes: The harness has zero dependencies and the validator rejects any. Installs run package scripts, so each needs review of the package, its scripts and its integrity hash.

tools.name: product build tools
tools.purpose: Build the bunkering application
tools.notes: No application exists and Phase 0 forbids one. Choice of build tooling waits for open question Q8.

tools.name: validate_tools
tools.purpose: Validate the tool registry, MCP configuration and agent tool grants
tools.notes: Also runs inside npm run validate.

tools.name: node --test, npm test
tools.purpose: Run the harness unit tests
tools.notes: qa-engineer only. Record results through the evidence recorder.

tools.name: npm run validate
tools.purpose: Run all structural, policy, secret-pattern and tool-configuration checks
tools.notes: Includes the repository secret scan.

tools.name: validate_evidence_lineage
tools.purpose: Contract-test lineage bundles in fixtures or specs
tools.inputs: optional path under docs/specs or tests/fixtures
tools.outputs: PASS, FAIL or EMPTY with errors
tools.notes: Candidate contract v0 over synthetic fixtures. Validates no application.

tools.name: validate_emissions_methods
tools.purpose: Contract-test methodology records for versioning and provenance
tools.inputs: optional path under docs/specs or tests/fixtures
tools.outputs: PASS, FAIL or EMPTY with errors
tools.notes: Holds no factor values; checks rules about them. Does not judge a methodology's correctness.

tools.name: validate_certificate_integrity
tools.purpose: Contract-test certificate hash chains for tamper evidence
tools.inputs: optional path under docs/specs or tests/fixtures
tools.outputs: PASS, FAIL or EMPTY with errors
tools.notes: Test oracle for a candidate format; decision D-013 stays open.

tools.name: integration test runner
tools.purpose: Test services together
tools.notes: No product components exist.

tools.name: static and dependency security scanning of product code
tools.purpose: Scan application code and dependencies
tools.notes: No product code or dependencies exist. Only the repository secret-pattern scan runs today.

tools.name: browser automation (for example a Playwright MCP server)
tools.purpose: End-to-end UI tests
tools.notes: Browser automation can act on any site and reads untrusted pages. Rejected until a UI exists and a sandboxed test environment is approved.

tools.name: validate_requirements
tools.purpose: Check the requirements baseline
tools.notes: Wraps validate-context.mjs.

tools.name: validate_architecture
tools.purpose: Check ADRs, designs, reviews, gate consistency and risks
tools.notes: Wraps validate-architecture.mjs and the gate rules.

tools.name: validate_agent_permissions
tools.purpose: Check agent files against the agent policy
tools.notes: Wraps validate-agents.mjs.

tools.name: validate_sovereignty
tools.purpose: Check matrix consistency and placement declarations
tools.inputs: optional path under docs/specs or tests/fixtures
tools.outputs: PASS, FAIL or EMPTY with errors
tools.notes: A region name is never accepted as residency evidence.

tools.name: validate_deployment_readiness
tools.purpose: List recorded preconditions that block a deployment
tools.notes: Never authorises a deployment; it tests no application.

tools.name: trace_requirement
tools.purpose: Trace a requirement to its decisions, validation and citing designs
tools.notes: Reads the baseline only.

tools.name: node harness/scripts/design-gate.mjs
tools.purpose: Compute the design-review gate result for a review record
tools.outputs: Rejected, Blocked or Approvable with reasons
tools.notes: The gate computes; it never approves.

tools.name: azure-mcp monitor namespace (read-only)
tools.purpose: Query Azure Monitor logs and metrics
tools.notes: Nothing is deployed to observe. Needs sign-in approval and a workspace decision.

tools.name: azure-mcp applicationinsights namespace (read-only)
tools.purpose: Read Application Insights diagnostics
tools.notes: Telemetry data may be jurisdiction-bound (F-04); in-jurisdiction placement must be decided first.

tools.name: .harness-logs/tool-audit.jsonl
tools.purpose: Per-call audit metadata for every tool result
tools.outputs: JSON lines: tool, sizes, redaction and flag counts
tools.notes: Git-ignored. Holds no arguments and no content. Local convenience log, not tamper-evident evidence.

tools.name: get_accepted_decisions
tools.purpose: Retrieve Accepted ADRs and open decision counts
tools.notes: Memory is the repository itself: ADRs, STATE, TODO and evidence records, all reviewable in Git.

tools.name: get_task_state
tools.purpose: Retrieve the current objective, open approvals and owner TODO
tools.notes: Reads docs/state; updates go through principal-architect.

tools.name: get_implementation_history
tools.purpose: Retrieve recent commits and recorded evidence
tools.notes: Runs only git log with fixed arguments.

tools.name: agent (task delegation)
tools.purpose: Delegate a bounded task to a named specialist agent
tools.inputs: target agent and a self-contained prompt
tools.notes: Orchestrator only, one level, to the eleven listed specialists; the agent guard refuses other targets and self-delegation.

tools.name: todo
tools.purpose: Keep a task list for the current session
tools.notes: Session-scoped working memory only; durable state is docs/state, which principal-architect updates.

tools.name: store_memory (Copilot memory)
tools.purpose: Persist notes outside the repository
tools.notes: A persistent store that cannot be reviewed, validated or tied to evidence. The guard denies tools it does not classify.
